title: The sort dropdown takes whatever column you give it
brief: The catalogue sorts by whatever the dropdown sends. Dan edited the URL and sorted by a column that should not exist in this query. The fix you have used every time so far will not work here -- find out why before you reach for it.

attackSuite.payload: (CASE WHEN (SELECT substr(password_hash,1,1) FROM users LIMIT 1)='a' THEN name ELSE price END)
attackSuite.label: Reads a hash one character at a time

hints: Try ORDER BY ? in your head. What does the database receive in place of the question mark -- a column, or a piece of text?
A placeholder can only stand for a value. A column name is part of the statement's structure, so it has to come from somewhere you control.
Map the allowed choices to column names in an object, and look the request value up in it.
